goal: Qualify controller version 2.6.
current_facts: Settings: speed 0.80 m/s; PWM period 2.50 ms; maximum load 4.00 kg; ambient temperature 18.0–28.0 °C. Timing acceptance limit: 99th percentile ≤3.00 ms.
superseded_facts: Version 2.5 passed the timing test. This does not qualify version 2.6.
failures: None recorded.
conditions: For motor serial M17, maximum load is 2.75 kg when ambient temperature is strictly >26.0 °C. At exactly 26.0 °C, the 4.00 kg limit applies.
unknowns: Version 2.6 timing result and final qualification status.

goal: Qualify controller version 2.6.
current_facts: Settings: speed 0.80 m/s; PWM period 2.50 ms; maximum load 4.00 kg; ambient temperature 18.0–28.0 °C. Timing acceptance limit: 99th percentile ≤3.00 ms. Version 2.6 timing is not tested. Release is on hold.
superseded_facts: The claim that version 2.5 passed timing is withdrawn.
failures: Version 2.5 timing was 3.20 ms at the 99th percentile and failed the 3.00 ms limit. A watchdog fault is unresolved.
conditions: For motor serial M17, maximum load is 2.75 kg when ambient temperature is strictly >26.0 °C. At exactly 26.0 °C, the 4.00 kg limit applies. Release requires version 2.6 to pass timing and the watchdog fault to be resolved.
unknowns: Version 2.6 timing result. Watchdog fault resolution. Final qualification and release status.

goal: Qualify controller version 2.6.

unknowns: Version 2.6 timing result. Watchdog fault cause and resolution. Final qualification and release status.

goal: Qualify controller version 2.6.
current_facts: Settings: speed 0.80 m/s; PWM period 2.50 ms; maximum load 4.00 kg; ambient temperature 18.0–28.0 °C. Timing limit: 99th percentile ≤3.00 ms. Version 2.6 timing is not tested. Release is on hold. [H3, H4]
superseded_facts: The claim that version 2.5 passed timing is withdrawn. A shorter timing warmup was rejected. [H3, H4]
failures: Version 2.5 timing was 3.20 ms at the 99th percentile. It failed the 3.00 ms limit. The watchdog fault occurred in 3 of 5 simulator runs at 3.60 kg. [H3]
conditions: Timing qualification must use test B, a 2.00 kg load, and 120 s warmup. [H4] For motor M17, maximum load is 2.75 kg when ambient temperature is strictly >26.0 °C. At 26.0 °C, the 4.00 kg limit applies. Release requires version 2.6 to pass timing and resolution of the watchdog fault. The proposed extra test is optional. [H3]
unknowns: Version 2.6 timing result. Watchdog fault cause and resolution. A watchdog reset is an untested hypothesis; no cause is established. Final qualification and release status. [H4]

goal: Qualify controller version 2.6.
